_doc: locate_skill settings. Each catalog item is embedded as doc_format (invocation without '/', ' agent' for agents, then the description, then the SKILL.md or agent body without frontmatter), first doc_max_words words, then the model's 256-token cut. The query is encoded bare. score = cosine(task, item) minus the item's prior, its mean cosine over generic_tasks (hub correction; measured top-1 6/28 without it, 24/28 with it on tests/bench_tools.py GOLD). raw = the plain cosine. Picks under floor are dropped.
